headline: Treasury designated 210 Opportunity Zone tracts in New York City on the new map.
New York State received 430 Opportunity Zone designations, 210 of them in the five boroughs.
New York City previously had 306 Opportunity Zones under the 2018 map, so the new total is 96 fewer.
The Opportunity Zone program is now permanent, with 10-year redesignations effective January 1, 2027.
Bushburg Properties is under contract to buy 60 Wall Street from GIC for $400 million, less than half its 2017 price.
Atlas Capital Group bought 360 West 43rd Street in Hell's Kitchen off-market for $142.5 million.
The Heisman Trophy signed a 10-year lease at Silverstein's landmarked 120 Broadway.
